summaries.purestorage-mts: Member of Technical Staff, Backend with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Go, cloud-native microservices, and distributed systems architecture. Authored 11 AWS log-source tables and shipped core Go features for Tailpipe at Turbot HQ, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ events per second at scale.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes at scale; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a cloud-native SaaS platform; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Authored 11 AWS log-source tables for Tailpipe in Go and 25+ pre-built security detections; designed standardized exit-code handling and a cross-platform smoke-test pipeline (CentOS, Ubuntu ARM64, macOS) for quality assurance across environments.
Built a Kafka-based, event-driven distributed pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for reliable failure handling and debugging.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff — investigating pod logs and status and collaborating with the platform team to restore service.
Owned release engineering end-to-end for four open-source Go CLIs — unified GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, automated smoke tests across Linux distributions, and GHCR Docker image tagging.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, and PR creation — using AI tooling as part of my daily engineering workflow; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90%.
